# Fantasy Basketball Mock Draft - Pick 8 In A 9 Cat H2H Draft

Locked On Fantasy Basketball, 2026-09-24, 45:05. https://youtu.be/_vbAP5y182A

## Summary

Josh Lloyd runs a 12-team, 9-category head-to-head mock draft on Fantrax, picking 8th. He takes Anthony Edwards in round 1 and Austin Reaves in round 2. He follows with Lauri Markkanen, Jaren Jackson Jr., Onyeka Okongwu, Franz Wagner, Damian Lillard, Isaiah Hartenstein, CJ McCollum, Jusuf Nurkic, Paul Reed, Reed Sheppard, Isaiah... Jarace? no: Oso Ighodaro and Jaylin? MZ Johnson as late flyers. In almost every round from round 3 on, the player he wanted went one pick before his turn. That pushed his team toward blocks, weak assists and late fliers. Along the way he flags picks he sees as reaches (Jalen Johnson at 9, Stephon Castle, Darryn Peterson, Anthony Black, AJ Mitchell) and values (Tyrese Haliburton, Tyler Herro, Brandon Ingram, Michael Porter Jr.). He also reacts to a report that Jeremiah Fears and Yves Missi may start in New Orleans. His team finished first in the projected standings.
